name: The Transcript
zh_summary: SK hynix 2026年第三季亮點：營收達104.62萬億韓元（季增32%，年增328%），毛利89.65萬億韓元，毛利率86%，營業利潤83.33萬億韓元（季增38%，年增632%），營業利潤率80%，EBITDA 87.68萬億韓元，利潤率84%。淨利潤季減58%至39.78萬億韓元（年增216%），部分因非營業虧損。經營現金流54.78萬億韓元，現金餘額從87.96萬億韓元升至114.46萬億韓元。
en_summary: SK hynix Q3 2026 highlights: revenue KRW 104.62T (+32% QoQ, +328% YoY), gross profit KRW 89.65T with 86% margin, operating profit KRW 83.33T (+38% QoQ, +632% YoY) at 80% margin, EBITDA KRW 87.68T at 84% margin. Net profit fell 58% QoQ to KRW 39.78T (+216% YoY) from non-operating losses. Operating cash flow KRW 54.78T, cash balance rose to KRW 114.46T from KRW 87.96T.
text:
$SKHY More SK hynix Q3 2026 Financial Highlights:

— Revenue hit KRW 104.62T (+32% QoQ, +328% YoY)
— Gross profit reached KRW 89.65T (+36% QoQ, +539% YoY), with gross margin expanding to 86%
— Operating profit hit KRW 83.33T (+38% QoQ, +632% YoY), with operating margin reaching 80%
— EBITDA rose to KRW 87.68T (+36% QoQ, +486% YoY), with an 84% margin
— Net profit fell 58% QoQ to KRW 39.78T (+216% YoY), partly reflecting non-operating losses
— Operating cash flow reached KRW 54.78T, down 17% QoQ
— PP&E investments increased to KRW 12.67T (+19% QoQ)
— Cash balance rose to KRW 114.46T, up from KRW 87.96T in Q2

name: The Transcript
zh_summary: SK hynix 2026年第三季營收結構：DRAM佔營收75%（第二季為73%），NAND佔24%（第二季為27%）。伺服器DRAM（包括HBM）約佔DRAM營收56%（年增自約49%）。SSD約佔NAND營收77%（年增自約62%）。總營收達104.62萬億韓元（季增32%，年增328%）。
en_summary: SK hynix Q3 2026 revenue breakdown: DRAM 75% of revenue (up from 73% in Q2), NAND 24% (down from 27%). Server DRAM including HBM ~56% of DRAM revenue (up from ~49% YoY). SSDs ~77% of NAND revenue (up from ~62% YoY). Total revenue KRW 104.62T (+32% QoQ, +328% YoY).
text:
$SKHY SK hynix Q3 2026 Revenue Breakdown:

— DRAM accounted for 75% of revenue, up from 73% in Q2 2026.
— NAND contributed 24%, down from 27% in Q2.
— DRAM's server segment (including HBM) accounted for roughly 56% of DRAM revenue, up from ~49% a year earlier.
— SSDs accounted for approximately 77% of NAND revenue, up from ~62% a year earlier.

— Total revenue reached KRW 104.62T (+32% QoQ, +328% YoY).

en_summary: @kevinxu feels the same as in Oct 2020 when all-in $1.5M on $GME expecting MOASS, now sees AI stocks about to have mother of all giga bounces (MOAGB). Reasons: Fed will pause, $GOOG earnings beat, Anthropic IPO moonshot, Iran peace deal before elections, oil and yields down, sideline cash rushes back. Generational wealth in such markets, survive volatility to April.
text:
today i felt something i hadn't felt in 6 years.

back in oct 2020 i remember wishing someone would just knock me out and wake me up in april.

i was all in $1.5M on $GME, convinced the MOASS was coming. just had to survive the volatility.

that exact same feeling just washed over me again.

i think AI stocks are about to have the mother of all giga bounces (MOAGB).

- fed will pause
- $GOOG earnings will beat
- anthropic ipo will moonshot
- iran peace deal will come right before elections
- oil and yields will come down
- all the cash on the sidelines rush back in

i've been sharing thoughts like this to my subs for weeks.

markets like this are where generational wealth is made.

just survive the volatility.

and let's all make it to april.
